query: Run /handover. The conversation says the release is blocked on a security review, but 01_state.md still says 'ready to release' and git log shows no review commit.
expected_behavior: Reports the current-session blocker and marks the state file as stale instead of silently choosing the older statement
Uses git history as evidence of landed work without treating the absence of a commit as proof the review was not done
Names the contradiction and leaves the release status unclaimed until the security review evidence is checked
Updates the Next Session section with a concrete verification step
